cls: Prostaglandin D2 receptor (DP1) antagonist (with niacin), withdrawn
pharm: Prostaglandin D2 receptor (DP1) antagonist (with niacin), withdrawn
quick: Niacin 1 g + laropiprant 20 mg daily, increased to 2 g/40 mg
summary: Laropiprant blocks prostaglandin D2-mediated niacin flushing. Niacin/laropiprant was withdrawn worldwide in 2013 after the HPS2-THRIVE trial showed no cardiovascular benefit and more serious adverse events. Do not start it.

dosage.d: Niacin 1 g + laropiprant 20 mg daily, increased to 2 g/40 mg

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: DP1 receptor antagonism reduces niacin-induced cutaneous vasodilation.
preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk

serious: Bleeding, infection, new diabetes and myopathy excess (HPS2-THRIVE, with niacin)

counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
